purpose: Fail-closed binding of one release candidate to one exact source head, one CI execution and one exact distributable artifact set.
invariants: provenance.repository == empishaj/SAFOR
provenance.sourceCommitSha == provenance.workflowHeadSha
provenance.exactHeadRequired == true
artifact path set exactly equals the canonical seven distributable paths for version
every artifact path is normalized, relative, symlink-free and resolves inside the repository root
checksumFile exactly equals SHA256SUMS-{version}.txt and resolves inside the repository root
every artifact.generatedFromSourceCommit == provenance.sourceCommitSha
every artifact.sha256 == SHA256(actual artifact bytes)
artifactSetDigest == canonical SHA256 of the ordered artifact identity records
checksum file path set exactly equals the artifact path set
checksum values exactly equal every artifact.sha256
checksumFileSha256 == SHA256(actual checksum file bytes)
PASS requires validation.status == PASS
PASS requires validation.validationSourceCommitSha == provenance.sourceCommitSha
PASS requires validation.validationWorkflowHeadSha == provenance.workflowHeadSha
PASS requires validation.validationWorkflowRunId == provenance.workflowRunId
PASS requires validation.validatedArtifactSetDigest == artifactSetDigest
PASS requires validation.validatedChecksumFileSha256 == checksumFileSha256
LOCAL workflow evidence may never authorize MATERIALIZED_AND_AUTOMATED_VALIDATION_PASS
during CI validation provenance.sourceTreeSha == git tree of provenance.sourceCommitSha at the checked-out exact head
provenance.workflowRunAttempt is a positive integer and matches the current workflow attempt when CI context is asserted
provenance.integrationRef is nonempty and matches the exact workflow source ref when CI context is asserted
validator required-field sets exactly equal this contract's required field lists
product == SAFOR
createdAt and materializedAt are UTC Z timestamps and createdAt <= materializedAt
PASS requires a nonempty validatedCommands list
PASS requires validation.validatedAt to be a UTC Z timestamp at or after materializedAt
every artifact.bytes is a nonnegative integer
prohibitedClaims: A prior successful workflow proves a later changed source tree.
Updating artifact hashes without exact-source CI provenance is sufficient release evidence.
Artifact existence alone proves materialization correctness.
Matching hashes for arbitrary or out-of-root paths may substitute for the canonical release artifact set.
A matching commit SHA with a mismatched source tree, workflow attempt or workflow source ref may authorize release PASS.
A PASS record with omitted contract-required fields, invalid temporal ordering, empty validation commands or non-integer artifact sizes is acceptable.
